author: reek
body: Reads sector 0 and sector 2 of the attached disk over raw IDE PIO -- the post-ExitBootServices path, driving the controller directly rather than through the block-read syscall. The .disk sidecar carries a signature at sector 0 and a different one at sector 2, so a passing run proves the LBA program reached the right sector, the word loop stored bytes in the right order, and a second command after the first completed.
